name: GF2 affine certificate economy

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "scripts/bench-2346-gf2-affine-certificate-economy.py"
      - ".github/workflows/gf2-affine-certificate-economy.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deterministic:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Compare direct coordinates and shortest generator paths
        run: python3 scripts/bench-2346-gf2-affine-certificate-economy.py
